title: Lumen
tagline: Take white light apart and put it back where it belongs.
description: Eighteen puzzles about light. Bend a beam with mirrors, cut it in two with a splitter, and break it into red, green and blue with a prism — then land exactly the right colour on every receptor. Colours add where they meet, so yellow is red and green arriving together. Every level has been proved solvable, and the game remembers which ones you have cleared and in how many pieces.
author: HexCave
controls: Click the tray, then click the grid
Right-click to pick a piece back up
howToPlay: Pick a piece from the tray at the bottom, then click an empty square to place it. Press R to turn the piece before placing it.
Click a piece you have already placed to rotate it; right-click it to take it back.
A mirror turns the beam ninety degrees. A splitter sends it two ways at once. A prism breaks it into red, green and blue — red bends right, green carries straight on, blue bends left.
Coloured glass keeps only its own colour, so white light through red glass comes out red.
Colours add where they land: red and green arriving together make yellow, and all three make white.
A receptor is only satisfied by exactly the colour it wants — too many colours is as wrong as too few.
goal: Light every receptor with exactly the colour it is asking for. All eighteen puzzles have been proved solvable.
